FIELD NOTES / 001

INFRASTRUCTURE, ONE STEP AT A TIME.

SELF-HOSTING · 1 MIN READ

A small start to repeatable deployments

One service, a clear configuration, and a little documentation go a long way.

Start small

A home lab does not need to begin with a dozen services. Pick one useful application, give it a home, and learn how it starts, stores data, and recovers after a restart.

Make it repeatable

Keep the configuration in Git and write down the deployment steps. The goal is simple: rebuilding the service should feel familiar instead of becoming a new investigation.

A working service is useful. A service you can rebuild is even better.

Leave a note

Record one thing that surprised you and one thing to improve next time. Those small notes become the most useful documentation in the lab.

Anthony Bluemel
